## Type of Issue

- [ ] **Bug Report** – Something isn't working as expected.
- [ ] **Feature Request** – I'd like to suggest a new feature or improvement.
- [ ] **Icon Missing / Incorrect** – An item is missing its icon or the icon is wrong.
- [ ] **Database Update** – The item data needs to be added, corrected, or removed.
- [ ] **Other** – Please describe.
